title: Ijwi ry'Ukurwanya
intro: Kera cane imbere y’uko umuntu wa mbere agenda kw’isi, hari ikiremwa c’ububasha burengeye urugero cari gihagaze mu karere k’amahoro atunganye, gikikujwe n’abantu bihebeye Imana kuruta abandi bose. Iyo hatanzwe itegeko rimwe, ijwi ryose ryarapfukama mu kuyoboka—ariko ijwi rimwe ryaraduga mu gutera umugongo, kandi ukwo gutera umugongo kwari gusubiramwo mu bihe vyose gushika ku Musi wa nyuma. None uwo muntu yaguye ni nde?
clues: Naremwe n’ikintu caka cane, mu gihe abandi bari iruhande yanje baremwe n’ivyo bagendeyeko.
Nabaye ahantu heranda hagati y’ibiremwa vyihebeye Imana, gushika aho itegeko rimwe rihinduye vyose.
Itegeko ryaje, umuntu wese arapfukama kiretse jewe; kwanka kwanje kwavutse ku bwibone.
Naciye nirukanwa muri ico kibanza ceranda, nshirwako ikimenyetso c’umuvumo uzogumaho ibihe bidahera.
Narasenga ngo bampe umwanya gushika ku musi w’Izuka, barampa. Narahiye kwegera umutima wose nkawuzimiza.
Inzumbete niyavuga, abankurikiye bazosangira iherezo ryanje, bazokwifatanya nanje mu muriro ururumba aho ata mufasha ashobora kubakiza.

trial.label: Igihe gisobanura
options: Gutegura umugambi wo gutera umugororotsi mu muriro .

location.label: Ikibanza ceranda
options: Ingoro nziza cane iri ku ruzi Nili .
Inyana y'inzahabu ikozwe mu vyo gushariza

outcome.label: Iherezo ryanyuma
options: Nimwirukanwe, muruhuke gushika ku musi w’isezerano .
outcome.answer: Nimwirukanwe, muruhuke gushika ku musi w’isezerano .

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
